title: Complaint Escalation and Nodal Officer Referral
content:
Complaint Escalation and Nodal Officer Referral

Document ID: SOP_C16_COMPLAINT_ESCALATION

Category: C16 — Complaints & Grievances

Department: Customer Care

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To define the tiered escalation process for complaints exceeding standard resolution SLAs, aligned to TRAI's grievance redressal framework.

Procedure

Tier 1 (Customer Care): target resolution within 3-7 working days depending on complaint category.

If unresolved at Tier 1 SLA expiry, auto-escalate to the circle Nodal Officer with full ticket history.

Nodal Officer reviews and responds within 2 additional working days.

If still unresolved, escalate to the Appellate Authority, and inform the customer of their right to approach TRAI/consumer forum if applicable.
